MSBI.thesis: MSBI's earnings normalization is now verified by primary filings rather than modeled: consecutive GAAP diluted EPS of $0.74 and $0.82 bracket the -$0.24 Q4'25 loss, so forward EPS of ~$3.38 is the printed first-half run-rate annualized and 9.8x forward is arithmetic. The driver is the highest-quality kind for a bank — spread and funding mix (loan repricing plus $267M of core deposits displacing brokered funding), not volume or leverage — showing up pre-provision at PPNR/assets of 2.01% and at ROTCE 16.27%, while the balance sheet de-risks via $94.9M of specialty-finance runoff and CET1 builds to 10.39%. The mispricing is structural neglect, not disagreement: four analysts at a 3.0 Hold with a $33.25 target anchored to a damaged trailing record that mechanically must be marked up as the run-rate repeats. At 1.5x book on a mid-teens ROTCE, 11-12x forward maps to $37-41 against a stoppable break of the 50-DMA and a soft book floor near $22-27. This is a shares-only, revision-cycle position sized modestly for small-cap gap risk, not a compounder — loans are shrinking and NIM expansion is already decelerating.

PEB.thesis: PEB's retained portfolio is compounding faster than the consolidated numbers show: the -0.1% headline revenue is a disposition artifact and the correct unit is per-share AFFO (+23.8% YTD), driven by genuine operating leverage plus a contracted 27%/$6.1M property-insurance cut that flows through May 2027 with zero further RevPAR help. Sell-side is stale and mechanically behind — 15 analysts at a 2.81 hold with an $18.62 mean target set before the 7/29 beat-and-raise, against a revisions factor of 73.7 that is the only evidence leg in this packet not collinear with price — so estimate and target markups, not multiple expansion, are the identified re-rate path. Downside is anchored (not floored) by $2.15B equity against $4.89B net hotel book on already-depreciated urban/resort assets, with the trend intact above a rising 50/200-DMA and RSI at 54.4 after a +38% quarter — confirmation-stage entry without paying for extension. I explicitly do NOT underwrite the $258M company-defined FCF at face value (capex lull) nor claim a cash-flow discount at 10-11x EV/EBITDA, and I treat the 30Y-at-2007-highs rate regime as a hard size cap on a 4-5.5x-levered REIT rather than as a veto, because that input reaches me through the news tape this firm has measured as net-harmful to conviction. Standard-size shares position, 6-12 month horizon, sized as correlated duration risk.

XHR.thesis: XHR's GAAP print is structurally uninformative — $1.14B of accumulated depreciation on $3.56B gross property makes the -$0.14 EPS and -0.6% ROE artifacts — while the same 8-K raised every metric that pays a REIT holder, putting the stock at ~10.1x AFFO and ~11.9x EV/EBITDAre on a Ritz-Carlton/Andaz portfolio at roughly $360k/key. Total RevPAR guided above room RevPAR means out-of-room group and F&B spend is outgrowing rate, the higher-quality flavor of lodging upside, and revisions at 86.4 say the estimate cycle is still moving up rather than marked. The entry is the desk's own pre-specified reset — RSI 47.2 with price above the 50- and 200-DMA after +20.65pts of 3m idiosyncratic relative strength — at a price 4.9% below my last HOLD on better fundamentals. But the upside is capped near a consensus target only 4% away, the business has no moat and burns ~28% of EBITDAre on maintenance capex annually, and a 4.6x-levered balance sheet into a 30Y yield at post-2007 highs is an unresolved discount-rate headwind I am sizing for, not overriding. Starter position in shares only, with the add level encoded above the year-ago supply shelf.
